motivation: Real Codex event_msg/token_count records contain total_token_usage and last_token_usage; they previously counted as unsupported.

contract.identity: Hashed observed session identity; raw IDs and log paths are not exported
contract.selection: Latest supported timestamp inside the selected window per identity. Never sum snapshots or different sessions.
contract.sameTimestampConflict: All counter values become unknown until a strictly newer supported observation
contract.counterDecrease: Use latest timestamp, not maximum counter
contract.noTotalFallback: last_token_usage alone does not invent a request or cumulative count

realNumericProjection.boundary: Only native numeric event projections of bounded real log tails. Not complete original sessions, daily usage, billing, or tool cost. Actual cumulative counter values remain in private local artifacts.

checked: Chinese explanation and rows align left
No absent counter rendered as zero

validation.renderHelperRepair: Include existing OuterToolUsageBreakdown source dependency when compiling the native panel.

sources.supports: Cache accounting is distinct from adding cached counters to input; not authority for Codex JSONL lifetime or billing semantics.
